I replied to Pree in a thread on her #central-team message. I couldn't confirm or rule out the 8 April renewal date for Brackenwater Freight Co.

- **Files:** none of the shared files Pree can see cover Brackenwater, so there's no contract, CRM note or account file to check the date against.
- **Channels:** nobody has mentioned a Brackenwater renewal date in the channels she's in.
- **Knowledge brain:** gbrain had no Brackenwater renewal date either. Its search was keyword-only, so I can't rule out that it missed something. The one Brackenwater mention was a public note saying the account moved to Marcus Lindqvist on the North team in September 2025, and it had no renewal details.

I told her to treat the date as hearsay until the account owner checks it against the signed paperwork, and offered to pass it on to them as unverified. I haven't recorded the date anywhere or contacted anyone else.
